nodes.label: AgenticWorkspace
nodes.description:
A workspace in which an AI agent can re-run an Activity, plus the prompt that asks it to. This is the agentic counterpart of the executable provenance an Activity already carries: `command` and `container_image` tell a machine how to replay a step, while `regeneration_prompt` and `workspace_url` tell an agent how to.
It is typed `prov:Plan` because that is what it is in PROV terms — a description of intended execution, not the execution itself. The run remains the Activity; this is the recipe the agent follows. Keeping them separate matters: re-running a plan produces a NEW Activity, and conflating the two would make a regenerated result indistinguishable from the original.
WARNING ON REPRODUCIBILITY. A prompt is not a deterministic replay mechanism. The same prompt, workspace, and model can yield a different result run to run. Treat `regeneration_prompt` as documentation of intent that a human or agent can act on, NOT as a guarantee of bit-identical output — that is what `command` plus `container_image` plus `code_version` are for. Record the model and version actually used so a divergent re-run can at least be explained.

nodes.label: DAPPER - NIH Dataset Attribution and Provenance Profile
nodes.description:
A LinkML data model for DAPPER, the NIH Dataset Attribution and Provenance Profile. Every dataset returned through an NIH MCP server should carry enough structured metadata for an AI system to cite the dataset, identify its creators, link to the primary publication, report the NIH grant/award that supported it, and describe the provenance of the returned result.
This is the profile's entry point. It defines no classes of its own; it imports the modules below, and tools and validation start here.

  core.yaml. What is tracked: the knowledge-graph skeleton, identity,
    citation/funding/provenance (JSON-LD + DataCite + PROV-O + schema.org),
    GA4GH DRS, DUO, RO-Crate, BioCompute/IEEE-2791, embeddings, versioned
    collections (`Collection`, `ResultCollection`) and `ValueLocator`.

  claims.yaml. Scientific reasoning: `Proposition`, `Claim` and its scores,
    `EvidenceItem`, `Question` and `KnowledgeGap`, `ScientificAccount` and
    `Paragraph`. Conceptually aligned with SEPIO's Proposition and
    Statement model.

  genesets.yaml. `GeneSet` and `GeneSetCollection` (dig.geneset).

  cell_programs.yaml. `GeneProgram` and `CellState`.

  mechanisms.yaml. `MechanisticModel`, `CausalStep` and `Mechanism`.

  nanopub.yaml. The nanopublication quad, signature and lifecycle.

  dismech.yaml. `CorrespondsToDismech`, the instance-level DISMECH
    cross-walk.

  replay.yaml. `AgenticWorkspace`, the agentic replay path for an Activity.

  cfde.yaml. `C2M2File`, a File with CFDE C2M2 identifiers.

The schema is shaped as a Dock knowledge graph: NIH resources, agents, awards, publications, scientific accounts, and nanopublications are Node entities; attribution, provenance, and causal assertions are Edge relationships.

nodes.label: DAPPER gene programs and cell states
nodes.description: Single-cell structure. `GeneProgram` is a coordinated pattern of gene activity representing a biological process, e.g. a factor from cNMF/NMF/Spectra/WGCNA or a curated gene module; it extends the core `Set` with genes as members. `CellState` is the cellular phenotype defined by the combination of `GeneProgram`s active in a cell (or cell population) at once, as distinct from a cell TYPE (a Cell Ontology class), which is what lineage a cell belongs to rather than what functional state it is in.

nodes.label: DAPPER CFDE C2M2 files
nodes.description: `C2M2File`: a core `File` described by CFDE C2M2 (Crosscut Metadata Model) properties, as found in dig.geneset provenance graphs. Adds C2M2 identifiers and portal links; C2M2 field names are kept as attribute names.

nodes.label: DAPPER scientific claims
nodes.description: Scientific reasoning: propositions, attributed assessments and their evidence, and paragraph-oriented scientific accounts. core.yaml supplies HashableNode, ProvenancedResource, ValueLocator, DismechLinked, and the literal/relationship and identity slot mixins; mechanisms.yaml supplies MechanisticModel.

nodes.label: DAPPER core - attribution, provenance and identity
nodes.description:
The domain-neutral core of DAPPER, the NIH Dataset Attribution and Provenance Profile: the knowledge-graph skeleton (Node, HashableNode, Edge), the identity axis (hashable / unhashable), citation, funding and provenance (JSON-LD + DataCite + PROV-O + schema.org), GA4GH DRS object identity, DUO data-use terms, RO-Crate packaging, BioCompute/IEEE-2791 workflow provenance, embeddings, and versioned collections.
COLLECTIONS. `Collection` (abstract) is a Set whose members are other DAPPER records, with optional versioning. `ResultCollection` is one immutable version of a named collection of analysis results: Datasets of result files identified by declared dimensions (`DimensionValue`, `FileRole`), the claim templates that mint Claims from them, and the query templates that read them. `GeneSetCollection` (genesets.yaml) also specializes Collection. `ValueLocator` pins the exact bytes of one value in a File, so evidence can ground in a result file.
Scientific reasoning lives in claims.yaml and each domain in its own module (genesets, cell_programs, mechanisms, nanopub, dismech, replay, cfde); dapper.yaml imports them all. A project that needs only attribution and provenance can import this module alone.

nodes.label: DAPPER DISMECH harmonization
nodes.description: Instance-level correspondence to the Monarch Initiative DISMECH disease-pathophysiology schema (https://w3id.org/monarch-initiative/dismech). DISMECH is not edited; harmonization lives on the DAPPER side as class mappings in each module, the core `DismechLinked` mixin, and the `CorrespondsToDismech` edge defined here.

nodes.label: DAPPER gene sets
nodes.description: Gene sets for the dig.geneset standard. `GeneSet` specializes the core `Set` with genes as members, and `GeneSetCollection` (a gene-set library) specializes the core `Collection`. `has_gmt_file` points a collection, or a single exported set, at the GMT File that serializes it.

nodes.label: DAPPER mechanistic models
nodes.description: Optional biological structure: `MechanisticModel`, its ordered `CausalStep`s, and the `Mechanism`s they invoke. A model holds structure and scope, not an assessment; confidence, review status and evidence live on Claim (claims.yaml), and a hypothesis is a Proposition's role within a ScientificAccount. CausalStep and CausalLinkTypeEnum are shaped like DISMECH's CausalEdge so chains round-trip without translation.

nodes.label: DAPPER nanopublications
nodes.description: The nanopublication model as used by the Nanodash / Knowledge Pixels stack: the Head/assertion/provenance/pubinfo quad and the npx signature and lifecycle (supersedes / retracts / introduces) terms. Lets a DAPPER object be emitted as, or minted from, a signed nanopublication. `AssertedIn` records that a Claim was published in one.

nodes.label: DAPPER agentic replay
nodes.description: `AgenticWorkspace`: the workspace and prompt an AI agent can use to re-run an `Activity`. The executable provenance an Activity carries (`command`, `container_image`, `code_version`) is the machine replay path; this is the agentic one, alongside it rather than instead of it. A prompt is NOT a deterministic replay mechanism, so the two are deliberately not interchangeable.

nodes.label: ancestry
nodes.description: Source-reported population grouping represented by a Dataset or targeted by an Activity. Omit when unknown or not applicable. This records analysis scope, not individual ancestry proportions or the participant classification method.

nodes.label: file
nodes.description: A File a value object points into: the file playing a FileRole, or the file whose bytes a ValueLocator addresses. Declared once here because both classes carry it as an attribute; each class refines it there.

nodes.label: has_embedding
nodes.description: Embedding records computed from this node (one per embedding model or text template). Available on every Node. Unhashable: attaching, replacing, or removing an embedding leaves the node's identifier unchanged. The forward, hashable direction is Embedding.embedding_of; if both are supplied they must agree.

nodes.label: has_gmt_file
nodes.description: Local File or C2M2File record serializing a gene-set collection, or a whole-file export of a single GeneSet. Use its content-derived DAPPER identifier, not a bare checksum or retrieval URL. A row in a shared GMT is selected with GeneSet.in_gmt_file and gmt_entry instead.

nodes.label: hashable
nodes.description: Marks a slot as constituting the identity of its instance. Changing its value changes the instance's digest and therefore its `id`.

nodes.label: id
nodes.description: Unique identifier for a node — a CURIE shorthand or a full URI. For a Dataset this is its persistent identifier (e.g. a DOI).

nodes.label: literal
nodes.description: Abstract base for scalar (data) attributes. Concrete scalar slots declare `is_a: literal`.

nodes.label: mechanistic_model
nodes.description: Optional mechanistic structure an assessment, proposition or account draws on.

nodes.label: name
nodes.description: Human-readable name/label for a node.

nodes.label: object
nodes.description: The object node of an Edge (its `id`/CURIE).

nodes.label: object_entity
nodes.description: Downstream (object) entity of a structured proposition or model.

nodes.label: predicate
nodes.description: The predicate (relationship type) of an Edge.

nodes.label: relationship
nodes.description: Abstract base for cross-references between nodes. Concrete reference slots declare `is_a: relationship` with `range: uriorcurie` and point at another node's `id`.

nodes.label: subject
nodes.description: The subject node of an Edge (its `id`/CURIE).

nodes.label: subject_entity
nodes.description: Upstream (subject) entity of a structured proposition or model.

nodes.label: trait
nodes.description: Identifier of the trait measured by a Dataset or targeted by an Activity. Prefer a stable catalog CURIE, such as KPN.TRAIT:0000096 for atrial fibrillation, over a source abbreviation such as AF. External trait definitions remain in their catalog; no local trait node is required.

nodes.label: unhashable
nodes.description: Marks a slot as excluded from the digest: temporal, environmental, signature, mirror-observed, or a back-reference derivable from a forward edge. Changing it MUST NOT change the instance's `id`.
